meta.subject: cdma update for yuv data cache before writing into sbuf and bit width limitation for large in wt dma

en.summary: The commit bundles two real CDMA hardware fixes: it stops planar-YUV line assembly from reusing the wrong cached fragment across planes, and it widens the weight-fetch delta so large DMA transfers do not overflow the entry counter.
why_it_counts: Both hunks modify active CDMA RTL in image and weight DMA datapaths.
The patch changes live cache-selection and transfer-accounting logic rather than tests, scripts, or comments.
The diff repairs concrete corruption and undercount mechanisms that match the commit subject.
disqualifiers: The commit contains two independent DUT fixes, so a fault-injection experiment should target one sub-fix at a time rather than revert the whole commit blindly.
evidence: NV_NVDLA_CDMA_IMG_sg.v adds a separate rsp_img_p1_cache_data register and switches the shifted-data splice between planar-0 and planar-1 cached fragments.
Before the change, one cache register was updated by both planar write enables, so the sbuf assembly path could combine current data with a fragment cached for the wrong plane.
NV_NVDLA_CDMA_wt.v widens incr_wt_cnt from 13 bits to 26 bits, subtracts the full wt_fetched_cnt values, and feeds the widened delta into incr_wt_entries_w.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: This commit contains two independent CDMA correctness fixes. For reusable fault injection, the cleaner primary target is the weight-fetch delta truncation bug: the DMA engine reports progress using a difference of cumulative fetch counters, and truncating that difference silently undercounts large transfers. The same commit also fixes a separate planar-image cache bug where a fragment cached for one YUV plane can be reused while assembling data for the other plane.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A long DMA transfer or group transition makes the fetched-count delta exceed the low-order slice that an implementation kept from the cumulative counter.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Truncate the fetched-count subtraction so only low bits are used when converting cumulative fetched bytes or atoms into newly fetched entries.
portability_notes: Map this to any DMA engine that computes progress from a running fetched-count register rather than from per-burst fixed increments.
The bug is not specific to weights; any cumulative-transfer delta that is later converted into entries, beats, or credits can suffer the same overflow.
Keep the consumer logic unchanged so only the delta computation is wrong.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the cumulative fetched-count register and the logic that computes newly fetched work as current_count minus previous_count.
Reduce that subtraction to a smaller slice width or cast it to a narrower temporary before the subtraction result is consumed.
Keep the downstream entry or credit conversion logic unchanged so the narrowed delta propagates into status updates.
Exercise a transfer large enough to cross the truncated range boundary.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix widens incr_wt_cnt to 26 bits, subtracts full wt_fetched_cnt values instead of only low 13 bits, and uses that widened delta to form incr_wt_entries_w.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore the old low-bit subtraction around wt_fetched_cnt and pre_wt_fetched_cnt in NV_NVDLA_CDMA_wt.v. The same commit also added a second planar cache register in NV_NVDLA_CDMA_IMG_sg.v for YUV image assembly.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Large weight transfers wrap the progress delta, so fetched-entry accounting becomes too small and downstream logic can believe fewer weights were fetched than actually arrived.
evidence_for_injection: The commit changes incr_wt_cnt from 13 bits to 26 bits.
The subtraction changes from wt_fetched_cnt[12:0] - pre_wt_fetched_cnt[12:0] to the full-width subtraction.
The widened delta is consumed immediately by incr_wt_entries_w, so truncation directly affects status accounting.
notes: A secondary injectable bug in the same commit is planar-cache reuse across YUV planes: reintroduce a single shared cached fragment for both planes if you want a data-corruption variant instead of a counter-overflow variant.
Inject only one sub-fix at a time for cleaner experiments.

zh.summary: 该提交捆绑了两个真实的 CDMA 硬件修复：它阻止 planar YUV 行拼接在不同 plane 之间复用错误的缓存片段，并扩展了 weight fetch 增量计数位宽，从而避免大 DMA 传输时条目计数溢出。
why_it_counts: 两个修改块都落在图像和权重 DMA 数据通路的活动 CDMA RTL 中。
补丁修改的是在线缓存选择和传输计数逻辑，而不是测试、脚本或注释。
差异修复了与提交标题一致的具体数据损坏和计数不足机制。
disqualifiers: 该提交包含两个相互独立的 DUT 修复，因此做故障注入时应一次只针对一个子修复，而不是盲目整体回退。
evidence: NV_NVDLA_CDMA_IMG_sg.v 新增独立的 rsp_img_p1_cache_data 寄存器，并在移位拼接时在 planar-0 与 planar-1 的缓存片段之间做选择。
在修复前，同一个缓存寄存器会被两个 planar 写使能共同更新，因此 sbuf 拼接路径可能把当前数据与错误 plane 的缓存片段拼在一起。
NV_NVDLA_CDMA_wt.v 将 incr_wt_cnt 从 13 位扩展到 26 位，改为对完整 wt_fetched_cnt 做减法，并把扩展后的差值送入 incr_wt_entries_w。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该提交包含两个相互独立的 CDMA 正确性修复。对于可复用的故障注入，首选目标是 weight fetch 增量被截断的 bug：DMA 引擎用累计抓取计数之差来表示进度，如果把这个差值截断，就会在大传输场景下静默少计。该提交同时还修复了另一处 planar 图像缓存 bug，即在组装另一条 YUV plane 数据时复用了前一条 plane 的缓存片段。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 长 DMA 传输或 group 切换使累计抓取计数之差超过实现中保留的低位范围。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把累计抓取计数的减法结果截断，只使用低位去表示新抓取的 entry 或 beat。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何通过累计抓取计数寄存器来计算进度的 DMA 引擎。
该 bug 不局限于权重路径；任何先算累计差值、再转换为 entry、beat 或 credit 的传输路径都可能出现同类溢出。
保持下游消费逻辑不变，只让差值计算本身出错。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到累计抓取计数寄存器，以及用 current_count 减 previous_count 计算新进度的逻辑。
把该减法缩窄为更小的位宽，或者先把计数转换成更窄的临时量再做减法。
保持下游的 entry 或 credit 转换逻辑不变，让错误的窄差值继续传播到状态更新。
使用足够长的传输以跨越被截断的计数边界。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CDMA 权重抓取进度计数逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 incr_wt_cnt 扩展到 26 位，不再只对 wt_fetched_cnt 的低 13 位做减法，并使用扩展后的差值生成 incr_wt_entries_w。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 NV_NVDLA_CDMA_wt.v 中恢复 wt_fetched_cnt 与 pre_wt_fetched_cnt 的旧低位减法。该提交还在 NV_NVDLA_CDMA_IMG_sg.v 中为 YUV 图像拼接新增了第二个 planar cache 寄存器。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 大规模 weight 传输会使进度增量回绕，从而把已抓取条目的统计变得过小，下游逻辑可能误以为到达的权重比实际更少。
evidence_for_injection: 提交把 incr_wt_cnt 从 13 位改为 26 位。
减法从 wt_fetched_cnt[12:0] - pre_wt_fetched_cnt[12:0] 改为完整位宽的减法。
扩展后的差值会立刻被 incr_wt_entries_w 消费，因此截断会直接影响状态计数。
notes: 同一提交里的另一个可注入 bug 是 YUV plane 之间的缓存片段复用：如果想要数据损坏型变体，可以重新引入单一共享缓存寄存器供两个 plane 共用。
为了实验更干净，建议一次只注入其中一个子修复。
